lessons.key: ac_gap::when an ac says a login auth flow embeds a db read value in the issued jwt write the test against the actual login oauth handler and decode the returned token a unit test that calls issuejwt directly with the value as a literal argument does not prove the handler wiring
lessons.text: When an AC says a login/auth flow embeds a DB-read value in the issued JWT, write the test against the actual login/OAuth handler and decode the returned token — a unit test that calls IssueJWT directly with the value as a literal argument does not prove the handler wiring.

lessons.key: spec_deviation::when a spec claims a role permission switch is unconditional for an entire request path e g all of app grep every handler under that path for direct pool usage before verifying the ac a sibling handler added before the feature e g file storage handlers can silently keep using the owner role and violate the absolute wording even though the new code is correct
lessons.text: When a spec claims a role/permission switch is unconditional for an entire request path (e.g. all of /{app}/...), grep every handler under that path for direct pool usage before verifying the AC — a sibling handler added before the feature (e.g. file/storage handlers) can silently keep using the owner role and violate the absolute wording even though the new code is correct.

lessons.key: ac_gap::when a ui section is gated behind a feature flag config toggle add an e2e test with the flag off asserting the section is absent not only the happy path test with it on
lessons.text: When a UI section is gated behind a feature flag/config toggle, add an e2e test with the flag off asserting the section is absent, not only the happy-path test with it on.

lessons.key: ac_gap::for any drawer modal dialog with cancel and confirm actions add a test for the cancel path asserting the underlying mutation was not called not just the confirm path
lessons.text: For any drawer/modal/dialog with Cancel and Confirm actions, add a test for the Cancel path asserting the underlying mutation was not called, not just the confirm path.

lessons.key: ac_gap::when a spec requires that a value outside the current configured options still displays correctly an orphan value add a test that seeds data with that out of list value before asserting the ui not only values already inside the list
lessons.text: When a spec requires that a value outside the current configured options still displays correctly (an orphan value), add a test that seeds data with that out-of-list value before asserting the UI, not only values already inside the list.
evidence: ROLECFG-12/ROLECFG-16 - validation.md P2 AC4 / P3 AC2 (frontend-e2e)

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::in playwright e2e tests a negative assertion tohavecount 0 or a positive assertion on text already present before the action under test tobevisible on pre existing dom content can pass vacuously if it resolves before an async render refetch settles assert on a stable post action marker or await the network response instead of relying on the first poll of a negative pre existing content check
lessons.text: In Playwright e2e tests, a negative assertion (toHaveCount(0)) or a positive assertion on text already present before the action under test (toBeVisible on pre-existing DOM content) can pass vacuously if it resolves before an async render/refetch settles - assert on a stable post-action marker or await the network response instead of relying on the first poll of a negative/pre-existing-content check.

lessons.key: ac_gap::for navigation ui composition features write e2e tests that click the real trigger card button tab trigger instead of page goto shortcuts goto only tests miss regressions in the actual wiring nav target tab switching in tab actions
lessons.text: For navigation/UI-composition features, write e2e tests that click the real trigger (card button, tab trigger) instead of page.goto shortcuts — goto-only tests miss regressions in the actual wiring (nav target, tab switching, in-tab actions).

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a form field s clear action must send an explicit empty value not omit the key add a dedicated e2e test that clears the field and asserts the exact empty value payload don t rely on backend acceptance of empty values as proof the frontend actually sends them
lessons.text: When a form field's clear action must send an explicit empty value (not omit the key), add a dedicated e2e test that clears the field and asserts the exact empty-value payload — don't rely on backend acceptance of empty values as proof the frontend actually sends them.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when an ac requires transactional abort or unconditional write behavior with no observable side effect difference add a test that directly forces the exact scenario mid tx failure injection resubmit identical payload instead of relying on the code structurally can t do otherwise
lessons.text: When an AC requires transactional-abort or unconditional-write behavior with no observable side effect difference, add a test that directly forces the exact scenario (mid-tx failure injection; resubmit-identical-payload) instead of relying on 'the code structurally can't do otherwise'.

lessons.key: gate_fail::when a task s done when checklist lists fewer scenarios than the test coverage matrix row above it treat the matrix as authoritative and add the missing scenario to done when before implementing not after
lessons.text: When a task's Done-when checklist lists fewer scenarios than the Test Coverage Matrix row above it, treat the matrix as authoritative and add the missing scenario to Done-when before implementing, not after.
evidence: tasks.md Test Coverage Matrix line 23 vs T2 Done-when

lessons.key: ac_gap::when a spec ac lists multiple parallel actions e g create edit delete rotate that must all hit an audit log verify each action actually has an implementation before marking the ac covered a missing action is a silent scope drop not a covered case
lessons.text: When a spec AC lists multiple parallel actions (e.g. create/edit/delete/rotate) that must all hit an audit log, verify each action actually has an implementation before marking the AC covered — a missing action is a silent scope drop, not a covered case.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a task s required e2e test is merged forward into a later task untestable until wired confirm the later task s test actually exercises the merged behavior e g the click to expand interaction not just the surrounding happy path
lessons.text: When a task's required e2e test is merged forward into a later task ('untestable until wired'), confirm the later task's test actually exercises the merged behavior (e.g. the click-to-expand interaction), not just the surrounding happy path.
evidence: spec.md P2 delivery-log AC2 / validation.md WEBHOOK-19 (test-coverage)

lessons.key: gate_fail::when a store row type has no json tags never writejson it directly or a slice of it always map through a response dto with explicit snake case tags and decode handler tests into that same dto not the internal row type or the test self masks the exact pascalcase vs snake case bug it should catch
lessons.text: When a store Row type has no json tags, never writeJSON it directly (or a slice of it) -- always map through a response DTO with explicit snake_case tags, and decode handler tests into that same DTO, not the internal Row type, or the test self-masks the exact PascalCase-vs-snake_case bug it should catch.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when a helper is applied at several call sites assert the behavior at every call site through the public entry point not just the helper in isolation
lessons.text: When a helper is applied at several call sites, assert the behavior at every call site through the public entry point, not just the helper in isolation.

lessons.key: ac_gap::cover every http verb an acceptance criterion names not only the read path that is easiest to assert
lessons.text: Cover every HTTP verb an acceptance criterion names, not only the read path that is easiest to assert.
evidence: spec.md AC P1-2 + Edge Cases (UPDATE/DELETE deny) (routes)

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when the spec requires a clear error assert the error message content not just that the error is non nil
lessons.text: When the spec requires a clear error, assert the error message content, not just that the error is non-nil.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::before writing an acceptance criterion that leans on an existing validation confirm that validation actually exists in the code path it names
lessons.text: Before writing an acceptance criterion that leans on an existing validation, confirm that validation actually exists in the code path it names.
evidence: spec.md AC P2-2; internal/provisioner/policy.go:231-233 (global policyOperators allowlist, no per-type check) (validation)

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a criterion promises unchanged generated output assert the generated string itself not only that behavior still passes
lessons.text: When a criterion promises unchanged generated output, assert the generated string itself, not only that behavior still passes.
evidence: spec.md AC P1-6 / tasks.md T2 Done-when; no generated-SQL comparison test exists (provisioner)

lessons.key: ac_gap::when migrating a modal s functionality into a new dedicated page add e2e assertions for the new page s own surface nav label route static content copy actions don t assume the migrated flow s existing test covers it
lessons.text: When migrating a modal's functionality into a new dedicated page, add e2e assertions for the new page's own surface (nav label, route, static content, copy actions) — don't assume the migrated flow's existing test covers it.

lessons.key: ac_gap::a single happy path e2e test that always has data in the list will never exercise empty state or error toast branches add an explicit test case that drives the list to empty and one that forces a mutation failure
lessons.text: A single happy-path e2e test that always has data in the list will never exercise empty-state or error-toast branches — add an explicit test case that drives the list to empty and one that forces a mutation failure.
evidence: MCPUI-13, MCPUI-14 (spec.md P3 edge cases); validation.md AC table (dashboard-ui-e2e)

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::for any nav item feature add an e2e test that clicks the nav link and asserts the resulting url not just that the link is visible direct page goto in beforeeach hides route path regressions in the nav config from ever being exercised
lessons.text: For any nav-item feature, add an e2e test that clicks the nav link and asserts the resulting URL, not just that the link is visible -- direct page.goto() in beforeEach hides route-path regressions in the nav config from ever being exercised.

lessons.key: ac_gap::when an ac requires a copy to clipboard action plus a specific success toast string add a test that actually clicks the copy control and asserts the toast text reading the copied value from a data attribute without clicking the button leaves the exact bug class wrong toast message uncaught by any test
lessons.text: When an AC requires a copy-to-clipboard action plus a specific success-toast string, add a test that actually clicks the copy control and asserts the toast text -- reading the copied value from a data attribute without clicking the button leaves the exact bug class (wrong toast message) uncaught by any test.

lessons.key: ac_gap::when a test loops the same assertion shape over multiple structurally different formats json vs toml etc verify the assertion against each format s real serialization instead of assuming the first format s shape generalizes
lessons.text: When a test loops the same assertion shape over multiple structurally-different formats (JSON vs TOML, etc.), verify the assertion against each format's real serialization instead of assuming the first format's shape generalizes.

lessons.key: gate_fail::an assertion placed after an earlier assertion in the same test function is unverified until the test is actually run end to end once a prior failure in the same test silently prevents later assertions from ever executing and static code review cannot detect this
lessons.text: An assertion placed after an earlier assertion in the same test function is unverified until the test is actually run end-to-end once — a prior failure in the same test silently prevents later assertions from ever executing, and static code review cannot detect this.
